basic_info.description: Behind the Spanish-Mediterranean facade you'll find this luxurious top floor condominium. Completely renovated and offering a floor plan perfect for today's lifestyle. This home offers a coveted open concept living, dining, and kitchen layout with generous oversized windows, which allow natural light to pour throughout the residence. The kitchen boasts a sizable island, quartz countertops, abundant high-end cabinetry, six burner Wolf range, and wine fridge. Located in the rear of the property, the primary en-suite bedroom offers a walk-in closet and spa-like bath with marble tiled walk-in shower, dual vanity, and water closet. The secondary bedrooms benefit from a hall bath complete with a soaking tub and separate walk-in shower. A powder room is conveniently available for guests. Details include central AC, engineered hardwood floors, beautiful arched openings, in-unit laundry, additional storage, two car parking, and a zen-inspired shared backyard. This flat Noe Valley location makes for an easy walk to shopping and dining along 24th Street. Enjoy Juri Commons Park and convenient access to 280 and 101.
